snippet.title: Log Away Halloween DLC - Out now!
snippet.description:
The Halloween DLC for Log Away is out now! 🎃

Get it now: https://the-mark.com/works/77/log-away-dlcs/

Turn your Retreat into a playful Halloween hideaway. Add pumpkin and spooky tables, ghost seating, spider lights, magic potions, a big pumpkin centerpiece, and a pet owl to keep you company, all wrapped in a calm Halloween soundtrack. Playful, a little spooky, and still completely cozy.

New to Log Away? Get the main game: https://the-mark.com/works/63/log-away/

#LogAway #LogAwayGame #CozyGames #Halloween
